title: Sustainable Building Construction
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Describe contemporary and emerging high-performance building codes and standards.
Recall common terminology used in energy efficiency, energy production, and renewable energy systems.
Analyze and select sustainable materials appropriate for a specific project.
Identify appropriate and efficient heating, cooling, and air quality control systems for a building, including heat recovery ventilation, passive, and insulation systems.

Apply the Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design® (LEED) rating system to a building project to assess sustainability, and properly document the assessment and prepare for the LEED Green Associate Examination.

notes: The page combines the A.S. degree and Certificate of Achievement (URL 'as-cert-achievement'); only one requirements list is printed, headed for the Certificate of Achievement, with Total Units 18.
Program Outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole; the certificate shares them and they are recorded here.
The General Education section applies to the Associate in Science degree, not to this certificate; it prints no GE units, so ge_pattern and ge_units are null.
DT 110 (Sustainable Technologies, 3 units) is required in the catalog but not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
Careers taken from the description 'a career in the fields of green building design, planning, construction and maintenance'; the split into four fields is a reading of that list.
